en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own move and get the same kind of budget and visa check
en.runTitle: A US-paid developer moving to Lisbon on the D8 visa for a year from April 2027: a monthly budget and the visa facts

fields.label: Nationalities and legal or tax residence
fields.placeholder: e.g. Brazilian citizen, tax resident in the US

fields.label: Age and insurance needs
fields.value: Health insurance that the visa requires

fields.label: Gross income, currency and employee or contractor status
fields.value: About USD 7,000 a month gross, paid by a US company

fields.label: Local call hours
fields.placeholder: e.g. US time-zone calls until 22:00 Lisbon time

en.template: Plan my stay in {city} from {arrival} to {departure} for {people}, with {nationality}, {insurance}, {income} and {calls}. Compare lean, base and cushion budgets, exact rental terms and late-hours workspaces. Separate spending, deposits, prepayments and emergency cash; count annual rent once. Check my visa route and tax obligations without assuming NHR/IFICI relief, show dated sources and what needs checking, and do not contact, apply, book, pay or publish.

phases.title: Read current Lisbon rentals, the official D8 rules and living costs
phases.judgment: On the visa’s income line it gave two figures and said how firm each is: €3,680 a month on the enacted 2026 minimum wage, €3,880 on the announced 2027 wage, to be rechecked once the implementing law is out. It also refused to assume either the old NHR or the IFICI tax regime applies.

phases.title: Build the editable budget workbook and a phone-friendly summary
Check the calculations, sources and files
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer re-checked the 123 formulas and found no errors, and confirmed that deposits and prepaid rent are not double-counted in the cash-flow figures. It also spot-checked the rental quote terms and primary sources, and the layout at phone width.

workers: Found furnished one-bedroom Lisbon listings and read each one directly for rent, deposit and contract terms
Read the official Portuguese sources on the D8 visa: income requirement, documents, fees, insurance and tax residence
Collected provider prices for the Navegante transport pass, coworking desks, internet and household costs
Independently audited the workbook, formulas and summary against the research notes

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你自己的搬迁计划，得到同样的预算和签证核对
zh.runTitle: 美国公司发薪的程序员，2027 年 4 月起凭 D8 签证到里斯本住一年：月度预算与签证要点

fields.label: 离境日期
fields.value: 约一年后(2028 年 4 月)

fields.label: 国籍及合法、税务居住地
fields.placeholder: 例如：巴西国籍，美国税务居民

fields.label: 税前收入及币种
fields.value: 税前约 7,000 美元/月，由美国公司支付

fields.label: 身份(雇员或承包者)
fields.placeholder: 例如：美国公司的全职雇员

fields.label: 当地通话时间
fields.placeholder: 例如：需要在里斯本时间 22:00 前与美国团队通话

zh.template: 请规划我从{arrival}至{departure}在{city}的远程工作生活，同行{people}，国籍及合法、税务居住地{nationality}，年龄和保险需求{insurance}，税前收入及币种{income}，身份{status}，当地通话时间{calls}；比较节俭、基准和宽裕预算、具体租约及晚间工位，分开消费、押金、预付租金和应急金，全年房租只算一次，核对签证与税务但不假定 NHR 或 IFICI 优惠，列来源日期和待确认事项，不联系、申请、预订、付款或发布。

phases.title: 查看里斯本当前租房、D8 官方规则和生活成本
phases.judgment: 对签证的收入线，它给了两个数字并说明各自有多牢靠：按已生效的 2026 年最低工资是每月 3,680 欧元，按已公布的 2027 年最低工资是 3,880 欧元，待实施法规出台后复查；同时它不假定旧的 NHR 或 IFICI 税收优惠适用。

phases.title: 做出可编辑的预算表和适合手机阅读的摘要
核对计算、来源和文件
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事重新检查了 123 个公式，没有出错，也确认现金流里的押金和预付租金没有重复计算；还抽查了租房报价条款和一手来源，并在手机宽度下查看了版面。

workers: 找带家具的一居室房源，并逐个读原页面上的租金、押金和合同条款
读葡萄牙官方资料里的 D8 签证：收入要求、材料、费用、保险和税务居住
收集 Navegante 交通卡、共享办公桌、网络和日常开销的服务商价格
对照调研笔记，独立复核预算表、公式和摘要
